svg.title: Just Eat Finder — Full-Info-Display Branch Architecture

g.text: Just Eat Finder — Full-Info-Display Branch Architecture
chips, Local Legends carousel, and pull-to-refresh.
useMainPageViewModel handles postcode submission & error states.
useRestaurantDetailViewModel dedupes deals and formats fee bands.
- api: postcode validation, enriched restaurant fetch, orchestration
- filtering: cuisine emojis, keyword search + shuffle, filter rules,
fee bands / free delivery, quick-filter chips
- sorting: rating / count / name orders + promoted placement
All components receive `theme` as a prop (from usePieTheme via
the pages). RestaurantCard formats distance via map/distance and
renders cuisines / free-delivery labels passed as props from
DisplayPage. FilterModal reads filter & sort configs directly.
filtering / search / layout chips / sorting / fees
API URLs / SortOrder / cuisine emoji map
